scope: Two private direct successors from the same immutable published MIR 1.0.0 F200 source save: one F200 candidate and one F210 engine-hop candidate. Each retains the source baseline, completes one new candidate gear laboratory, saves, and passes two read-only cold reloads. This evidence does not recreate or duplicate the source world and does not qualify a later candidate, arbitrary dependency closure, multiplayer, physical production, performance, or release acceptance.

source_stage_reused.reuse_limit: The source-stage laboratory count is historical work retained by the source chain. It is not additional successor work and the source world was not rerun.

frozen_execution.binding_note: The later tracked profile/README integration binds the accepted r08 containers but does not rename the frozen native source head or its two candidate packages.

fixture_owned_sentinel_boundary.configuration_rule: Before a write, each value must be either the observed engine reset value 0 or the saved snapshot value. Only zero is re-applied; an already-correct value is retained; every other value refuses before candidate work.
fixture_owned_sentinel_boundary.reload_rule: Cold reload assertions are pure and write no sentinel value.
fixture_owned_sentinel_boundary.representation_rule: The raw source effect signature is retained. The observer accepts only verified additive change-recipe-productivity ordering, omitted hidden=false, and the four exact source float32 projections; it preserves multiplicity and rejects all other effect drift.
fixture_owned_sentinel_boundary.claim_limit: This fixture lifecycle correction does not assert that MIR reconstructs unowned script or console modifiers.

custody.full_originals: All native results, saves, logs, preflights, configuration and library-control snapshots remain only in discoverable primary custody; this tracked chain carries hashes and safe summaries rather than those payloads.

pre_engine_same_slot_observer_copy_refus.disposition: The caller refused before a native result when its observer archive copy targeted the already-selected library path. It is retained separately from the five native fixture adverses.

receipts.exclusions: The compact capsule has five native adverses, two native passes, and one labelled derived marker record. It excludes save binaries, player/configuration data, raw preflight snapshots, full logs, and library-control payloads.

limitations: This is one protected published MIR 1.0.0 F200 origin, two exact frozen candidate packages, and two exact engine families. It neither covers every historical origin nor relabels BD1/58F observations as a later source/package; current-new-source applicability and VER-06 remain pending with the maintainer.
